scripts.db:push: node scripts/make-sqlite-schema.mjs && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/make-sqlite-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/make-sqlite-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && prisma db push --force-reset --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && tsx prisma/seed.ts
